facts.fact: The Council of Ministers of 4 February 2026 adopted a decree ratifying an IDA loan of 84,356,070,200 FCFA, concluded on 17 October 2025, to finance phase 1 of PADCI, which is to extend broadband connectivity to public structures including town halls (mairies) and sub-prefectures.
facts.system: Projet d'accélération digitale en Côte d'Ivoire (PADCI) phase 1

facts.fact: The government's communiqué presents PADCI phase 1 as the state's own project, financed by a loan the Republic of Côte d'Ivoire concluded with IDA on 17 October 2025 and ratified by decree on 4 February 2026.
facts.system: Projet d'accélération digitale en Côte d'Ivoire (PADCI) phase 1

facts.fact: The government spokesman said on 4 February 2026 that PADCI phase 1, a financed project of 84.36 billion FCFA, will in time extend broadband connectivity to public structures, naming town halls (mairies) among schools, health centres, social centres, sub-prefectures, tribunals, post offices and regional directorates.
facts.system: Projet d'accélération digitale en Côte d'Ivoire (PADCI) phase 1

facts.fact: On 4 February 2026 the Council of Ministers ratified by decree the IDA loan of 84,356,070,200 FCFA for PADCI phase 1, whose connectivity is to reach town halls among other public structures; the communiqué states the connection as a future result, not as made.
facts.system: Projet d'accélération digitale en Côte d'Ivoire (PADCI) phase 1
